docs/troubleshooting.md.patch:
--- a/docs/troubleshooting.md
+++ b/docs/troubleshooting.md
@@ -49,6 +49,23 @@
 
 `kogen init` needs only one signed-in route; it does not need ChatGPT when another route is available.
 
+### Context file cannot be used
+
+```
+intent/context_unavailable: /tmp/work/absent.txt: not found
+```
+
+`kogen intent build <slug> --context <file>` refuses when the file cannot be used. The line names the absolute path of the file and one cause, tested in this order:
+
+- `not found`: the path does not exist.
+- `not a regular file`: the path exists but is a directory, a socket or another non-file.
+- `unreadable`: the file cannot be opened or read.
+- `larger than 262144 bytes`: the file is longer than 262144 bytes.
+- `not valid UTF-8`: the file is not valid UTF-8.
+- `blank`: the file is empty or only whitespace.
+
+The path is resolved against the folder where you ran `kogen`, not against `--project`. If the absolute path is not the file you meant, run the command from the right folder or pass a full path.
+
 ## Build ids and Intents
 
 ### Not a Build id

wrong.name: path kept as typed
wrong.scenario: A missing file is named by its absolute path
wrong.step: And build-context-refusal-names-file-and-reason: the refusal line is exactly "intent/context_unavailable: <dir>/absent.txt: not found"

wrong.name: directory reported as not found
wrong.scenario: A directory is not reported as missing
wrong.step: And build-context-refusal-names-file-and-reason: the refusal line is exactly "intent/context_unavailable: <dir>/notes: not a regular file"

wrong.name: limit worded in KiB
wrong.scenario: The size limit is stated in bytes
wrong.step: And build-context-refusal-names-file-and-reason: the refusal line is exactly "intent/context_unavailable: <dir>/big.txt: larger than 262144 bytes"

wrong.name: binary reported as blank
wrong.scenario: Blank and binary files get different causes
wrong.step: And build-context-refusal-names-file-and-reason: the refusal line is exactly "intent/context_unavailable: <dir>/binary.bin: not valid UTF-8"

wrong.name: exact limit refused
wrong.scenario: A file of exactly 262144 bytes is still accepted

wrong.name: troubleshooting entry missing
wrong.scenario: The troubleshooting guide explains the refusal
wrong.step: Then build-context-refusal-names-file-and-reason: the troubleshooting guide has a context_unavailable entry with the six causes and the working folder
